description: Poll an Anthropic Message Batch's live processing_status (never trusting stale cached metadata); fire a Dagster run against the paired anthropic_batch_results asset once the batch reaches 'ended'. Cursor-deduped so downstream fires once per completion.

watch_asset_key.label: Watch Asset Key
watch_asset_key.description: The anthropic_batch_submit asset to watch for a batch_id in its materialization metadata.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to trigger once the watched batch reaches processing_status == 'ended'.

results_asset_key.label: Results Asset Key
results_asset_key.description: Asset key of the anthropic_batch_results asset this sensor's RunRequest targets. Used only to derive the correct op name (via AssetKey.to_python_identifier()) for run_config — not to look up anything at sensor-eval time.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Anthropic API key
